item.title: New wheels to drive farmer growth in East New Britain
item.description: East New Britain farmers have received a major boost following the presentation of a new vehicle to the East New Britain Growers Association at its project site in Vimy, Kokopo District, last Thursday. For hundreds of smallholder farmers engaged in poultry and cocoa production across the province, the new truck represents stronger logistical support to help move feed, chicks and produce more efficiently. item.title: Corn expected to generate more than K5 million
item.description: Papua New Guinea’s push to have a K30 billion economy by 2030 through the agriculture sector was highlighted on Tuesday during the Rumion Piggery Field Day held at the Umi Corn Farm Plantation in the Markham Valley of Morobe Province. The event featured the launching of the 2nd Corn Harvest of more than 550 hectares of land at the Umi Farm in Markham Valley. item.title: Central Bougainville Football Association hosts first Annual General Meeting
item.description: CENTRAL Bougainville Football Association (CBFA) hosted its first Annual General Meeting in arawa town community hall. item.title: Blackpink collabs with National Museum of Korea to celebrate upcoming EP ‘Deadline’
item.description: The National Museum of Korea will turn pink. Literally. The state-run museum has joined forces with K-pop girl group Blackpink to celebrate the quartet's upcoming EP "Deadline", set to drop on Feb. 27. National Museum of Korea will beam with Blackpink's signature shade of pink during the collaboration period starting from Feb. 27 to March 8.
